mechanism: Prochlorperazine may increase hepatic metabolism of pyrazinamide and both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism with potential for altered clearance; prochlorperazine can lower seizure threshold while pyrazinamide neurotoxicity may be potentiated.
action: Monitor for reduced pyrazinamide efficacy and increased prochlorperazine side effects; ensure adequate hepatic function monitoring and consider alternative antiemetics if tuberculosis treatment failure occurs.
